# The Exchange path move updates build, metrics, ownership and test references together

The move updates the protocol build directories and test directory, both configured Glean metric file lists, module ownership patterns and the historical files_changed fixture. The relocated test moz.build still names its unit and browser manifests. Two test-code changes only update source-reference comments. Seventy-two R100 pairs preserve complete blob identity, while components.conf and seven integration files require their actual changed hunks. These are source/configuration facts; no build, test selection, ownership export or metric upload was executed.

Scope: Exchange path integration.
